author: Rocco Gnappo
text:
For several reasons, my daughter has also had many discarded sensors lately.
They make blood at the application, they often lose the signal (and my daughter doesn't have much patience), sensor errors, sometimes scans with values very far from the real one…
The last time we contacted the call centre to replace the sensors they forced us to provide photos of them with box and now (3 days) we are still waiting for an answer. I have already guessed that we are in the crosshairs of their "black list".
I state that my daughter still has problems with hypo and glycaemic swings, sometimes it is enough for her to lose the signal 3/4 times to decide to change.
Ps. Use freestyle with ypsomed infuser.
